column1: # WHY THIS EXISTS. Every other check in this repo verifies INTENT: check_config greps the
# configure line embedded in the binary, and gen-matrix.sh reads the BUILD_* flags. Both answer
# "did we ask for it", never "did we get it". FFmpeg and the dependency build systems routinely
#   - Vulkan filters need spirv_compiler (n9) / spirv_library (n8). A too-old glslc, or a missing
#     --enable-libshaderc, disables them with no error. Every 8.1.2 artifact shipped with zero
#     Vulkan filters, and four RIDs did on 9.0.1, through a fully green matrix.
#   - libvmaf's meson marks xxd `required: false` and emits its built-in models only if found, so
#     the filter registers and then cannot load its own default model.
# Each row asserts that a flag in the artifact's OWN configure string corresponds to something
# actually registered in the binary. Expectations come from the artifact, so this needs no
# per-RID upkeep: enable a library anywhere and it is checked there.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Columns 2-3 drive check_claimed_capabilities, which RUNS ffmpeg and greps a listing. That
# covers only the RIDs whose binaries execute on a test runner (Linux, macOS, Windows).
# Columns 4-5 drive check_claimed_capabilities_static, for the cross-built slices that ship no
# CLI (Android .so, iOS/Catalyst frameworks). Those were previously verified by INTENT ALONE --
# which is precisely how android-arm64, ios-arm64 and maccatalyst each shipped --enable-vulkan
# with zero Vulkan filters in 9.0.1.7 and 8.1.2.7. Column 4 names the library the component
# registers in (avfilter / avcodec / avformat), column 5 the EXACT string to find there; "-"
# means the row has no static equivalent (the hwaccels that are desktop-only). Matching is
# exact-line: "scale" as a substring occurs 67 times in libavfilter.
# Keep the two sides consistent: a row's static-string should name the same component its
# regex matches, so neither check can quietly drift from the other.
# scale_vulkan specifically, NOT a loose /_vulkan/ match. A couple of Vulkan filters
# (avgblur_vulkan, bwdif_vulkan) need no SPIR-V compiler and survive even when the shader
# toolchain is missing, so a loose match passes a build that lost the other 16. Measured:
# published 8.1.2 linux-x64 has 2 vulkan filters, 9.0.1 has 18. scale_vulkan is in the
# SPIR-V-dependent set, so it is the honest canary.
# libsoxr registers NO filter, codec or format: it adds a resampler ENGINE to
# libswresample. The old row asserted the `aresample` filter, which FFmpeg builds
# unconditionally (its only dep is swresample) -- so that row passed on a build with no
# libsoxr at all. Verified against the artifact: `-h full` is the only CLI evidence that
# discriminates. No static equivalent: the engine name lives in libswresample, which the
# A top-level stack can be enabled while individual codecs inside it are silently dropped:
# FFmpeg probes NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS_AV1, CUVIDAV1PICPARAMS and the VAAPI HEVC/AV1 structs
# SEPARATELY from the stack itself, so an older header set yields a build with --enable-nvenc
# and no AV1 NVENC. The rows above would not notice: they only assert the stack. Each row here
# was MEASURED present in the published 9.0.1.7 artifacts of every RID that claims its flag
# (linux-x64, linux-arm64, win-x64, android-arm64, osx-arm64, ios-arm64), so they are
# Deliberately NOT asserted: scale_vt. It needs VTPixelTransferSessionCreate, which Apple marks
# available from macOS 10.8 but only iOS 16.0, while apple.sh builds iOS against
# -miphoneos-version-min=13.0 -- so FFmpeg's configure probe cannot use it there. Measured
# accordingly: present on osx-arm64, absent on ios-arm64, both claiming --enable-videotoolbox.
# A deployment-target difference, not a silent loss, and this table has no per-RID scoping by
# design (expectations come from the artifact's own configure line).
# No CLI columns: measured on the artifact, ffmpeg lists no per-codec d3d11va entry under
# -decoders (0 matches) and -hwaccels names only the stack. Static-only row.
